blocks.md: This lesson covers the book's section on **Multi-Turn Agentic RL**. Read the excerpt, then test yourself below.

blocks.source: Vol III, Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards, § Multi-Turn Agentic RL
blocks.md: In a single-turn response, the policy generates one contiguous block of tokens from one static prompt, so the final text holds the entire training example. In a multi-turn repair trial, however, the agent alternates between proposing actions (code edits, shell commands, or structured tool invocations) and reading observations returned by compilers, test runners, and the container runtime, while the harness compacts or truncates older turns to fit the context window.

blocks.title: What the section covers
blocks.md:
In the book this section runs through:

- Invocation records
- Policy actions and conditioning context
- Stopping and censored rollouts
- Collection and deployment contracts

blocks.prompt: Think first: In two or three sentences, explain why Faithful rollout records matters for the system this section describes.
blocks.md: Compare your answer with the book's claim: Ratios and gradients are valid only on per-invocation records of the delivered prefix token IDs, sampled token IDs, and behavior log probabilities under the actual sampling transforms.

questions.q: The section **Multi-Turn Agentic RL** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: A group whose rewards all tie carries no reward gradient, occurring with probability p^G + (1-p)^G, so the rollout cost of one informative group is G/C and difficulty targeting toward p near 0.5 lowers it.
A terminal reward gives every turn the same reward-to-go, so separating a useful step from a faulty one is bought with a critic, more samples, or step-level signals, each at its own cost.
Ratios and gradients are valid only on per-invocation records of the delivered prefix token IDs, sampled token IDs, and behavior log probabilities under the actual sampling transforms.
Symmetric ratio clipping is asymmetric in probability space, so early successes sharpen the policy until groups converge and contrast vanishes, which outcome statistics can diagnose.

questions.explanation: This section develops **Faithful rollout records**: Ratios and gradients are valid only on per-invocation records of the delivered prefix token IDs, sampled token IDs, and behavior log probabilities under the actual sampling transforms.
